notes.title: Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift Fogs Of War Update
notes.notes:
The long awaited Fogs of War update is finally here!

The update introduces one key new feature – the option to enable Line of Sight in multiplayer games (both online multiplayer and hotseat). If Line of Sight is enabled you will no longer see your opponent’s units in-game until they actually show up within your line of sight – just the way it works in the singleplayer campaign.

Check out this new feature and see how it greatly changes the experience of multiplayer skirmishes.  And if you’re looking for someone to play against, be sure to join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/Fruc8J6S

To make the news even more exciting, Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift is also 70% off until July 31st, so grab it now and tell your friends!

Have fun!

notes.title: TT:AS PLAYTEST - Fogs Of War Update is here
notes.notes:
PLAYTEST has officially started, with a slight slippage, but it's here.

During this PLAYTEST, we want to test the fog of war mechanics before we bring it to the game permanently.

Fog of War is a mechanic thanks to which we do not see units until they appear in our field of view.

During the PLAYTEST, the player will have a choice of two game modes: hotseat and multiplayer.

Hotseat - a mode in which on one computer can play against each other two human players as well as a human player against our AI.

Multiplayer - a mode in which one of the players starts an online game and the other joins it. In this mode, we can only play against human opponents.

We count on your feedback, how you play with this change, whether the battles are more interesting, more unpredictable, or maybe just the opposite - the game is worse. Let us know what you think about this change.

notes.title: Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift Playtest
notes.notes:
Hello,

In just a few days, we are opening the Multiplayer Playtest for everyone! Don’t have the game yet? Don’t worry! For two weeks, everyone can play, using everything that the multiplayer mode offers.
What to do to participate? Simply [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266890/Tactical_Troops_Anthracite_Shift/]sign up[/url].

If you join, you will be able to play both multiplayer modes - the devastator and the domination using a full arsenal of weapons (among others: SMGs, rifles, machine guns, rocket launches) and of course, dozens of one-of-a-kind items to match your unique game style.

[b]Why did we decide for the Multiplayer Playtest?[/b]

Because of [url=https://sensei.tacticaltroops.net/]Sensei[/url]. It’s our game analytic platform, which provides guides and support to players. You may think of it as a game specific mentor or coach, which helps you to analyze your game and playstyle.
But for [url=https://sensei.tacticaltroops.net/]Sensei[/url] to be a great coach it needs practice, well actually it needs data from game logs.

After [url=https://sensei.tacticaltroops.net/]Sensei[/url] has “seen” enough games, it can then help players improve their skills. You’ll get:

- replays of all of your games with various heatmaps (eg. best sniping position)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37470423/a517eda596922f82bdb5f58e37d596c2b3eb6ff8.png[/img]

- visualizations of the player's ranking change in time, 

- view of the most popular loadouts for different maps,

- insight to weapons and gadgets details,

- comprehensive facts about maps, units and game modes.

If we’ll manage to collect enough data, we will also  add advanced features such as:

- loadout completer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37470423/88000130e932d32a83171d52ceb5a2a414b897a2.png[/img]

- playstyle analysis

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37470423/144e46f0c6e95067d7d8372bb15cf4b165795c4f.png[/img]

- formations (how players spread their units on a map),

and more.

Sensei is also about peer mentoring. It allows for comparing individual statistics with the community of gamers and exchanging knowledge. On the Sensei platform, each of you can check yours and other players’ progress, view all your fights and see how other players deal with given maps.



[b]How to participate?[/b]

Just [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266890/Tactical_Troops_Anthracite_Shift/]sign up[/url] to Playtest and blow things up!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266890/Tactical_Troops_Anthracite_Shift/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37470423/85430ef53c2bc99d81a0ab2198ffe82020673b12.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift - Release Date
Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift - Important Updates
notes.notes:
Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift, previously scheduled for release on August 20th, has been postponed.

The story mode and the multiplayer mode are both fully complete and playable at this stage, but developer QED decided to take three extra months of work to improve the game, polish it and ultimately make it better.
As soon as we identify the new release date, we will make sure to let you know. 

To those who were eagerly waiting to play Tactical Troops, rest assured QED is working hard to deliver the best experience. It will all be worth the wait.

notes.title: Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift || Beta Call

If you're into tactical games with an indie flavour, sci-fi planets, if you feel like shooting some alien animals with a shotgun, AND if your secret dream is being able to teleport yourself around a grid-less map... we don't judge you. You're exactly the person we're looking for!

notes.title: Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift is coming soon
notes.notes:
In an effort to support innovative indie projects and to give them a bigger chance of being noticed, we are proud to announce the collaboration with up-and-coming Polish studio QED Games. Their first game is a turn-based tactical sci-fi game: [b]Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift[/b].

[previewyoutube=xaT9AkruW6k;full][/previewyoutube]

In Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift you will command a small troop of elite soldiers throughout the atmospheric, beautiful yet hostile planet of Anthracite.

[h3]SINGLE PLAYER CAMPAIGN AND MULTIPLAYER SKIRMISHES[/h3]
Explore the beauty and the danger of Anthracite by leading your troops through [b]40 missions of a story-rich single-player campaign[/b], or compete against your friends in the[b] fast-paced multiplayer skirmishes[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37470423/96bea66c539e314e57c4138bdac2d94b96543e88.jpg[/img]

[h3]OVERWATCH TECHNIQUE[/h3]
Thanks to your troops’ [b]overwatch technique[/b], you can automatically attack your enemies as soon as they enter your field of view. Choose the weapon, set the direction and your soldiers will patiently wait for the unlucky opponents who try to get in their way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37470423/e770f1f784288b4ec92daa785eca74248198c8dd.jpg[/img]

[h3]ALIVE, PHYSICS-BASED SCIENCE FICTION WORLD[/h3]
The combat system and the world of Anthracite follow the [b]rules of physics[/b]: weapons require manual aiming, bullets and grenades can bounce off obstacles. And if you target an explosive barrel near your enemies, well, they will have a hard time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37470423/78659c963a51780a1426f07fa42df5f33346c964.jpg[/img]

[h3]Anthracite needs your help![/h3]

Tactical Troops: Anthracite Shift is due to release on PC later this year. If you’re willing to provide feedback and to support QED Games, you can join the official [url=https://discord.gg/fQuXmv8]Discord Channel[/url] and apply for the [url=https://www.slitherine.com/beta/tactical-troops]Beta Test[/url].
